title: Closing a window vs. quitting
drDigitalIntro:
Closing a window and quitting an app are two different things.
• The yellow minus button minimizes the window — it hides it, but the app is still running. You can see it is still open because a green dot appears on the dock icon.
• The X button closes the window completely. On some apps, this also quits the app.
• Try both below: minimize the window, bring it back, then close it.

steps.say: Click the yellow minus button to minimize the window.
Click the Notes icon in the dock to bring it back.
Now close it with the X button.

drDigitalSuccess: Minimize hides a window. Close puts the app away. Now you can tell which one you just did.
drDigitalHint: Use the yellow minus to minimize, then click the icon in the dock to restore, then the X button to close.
